detail: TenderProof: criação exige título, órgão e número do edital com evidência reproduzida

root_cause.source_parser: ufu_selection_parser.preflight/parse requires DETAIL_URL as the candidate detail URL and proves title/orgao/edital/inscricao literals
root_cause.shared_dispatch_failure: fields.py checks artifact.url_requested == DETAIL_URL before invoking the strict parser; the persisted ReviewedRun correctly stores the linked administrative document URL, so all five replacements become FAILED and revalidation sees unsupported identity fields
root_cause.why_not_parser: the parser already rejects source/external drift, URL/hash/byte drift, truncation, empty/error HTML, U+FFFD and missing literal/date markers; changing DETAIL_URL to the detail page would make the persisted official document URL fail the adapter contract

minimum_shared_patch_for_T007: fields.py must compare the pinned administrative DOCUMENT_URL for artifact metadata while separately requiring candidate.detail_url_observed == DETAIL_PAGE_URL; then invoke this parser without promoting prova_data
